## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta4

### Faster dashboard hot path
- Add one final performance coordinator for the normal closed-dialog card path so unrelated Home Assistant state updates no longer traverse every historical Settings/Schedule/notification compatibility wrapper.
- Track only the selected mower's relevant entity state stamps during normal dashboard operation. Unrelated HA entity changes are ignored by the Map Card hot path.
- Keep the full compatibility path only while a modal dialog is actually open, or when the notification/custom-area compatibility entities themselves change.
- Avoid repeating `_ensureDom()` work once the card DOM already exists.

### Progressive visual rendering
- Keep static map geometry as the first payload work, then spread the remaining visible work over prioritized animation frames instead of doing every render in one frame.
- Render order is now: user-requested dialog first when applicable; visible map overlays (history/current-cycle trail + live trail); mower; footer/controls; session chips last.
- This intentionally favors perceived map readiness: the lawn/map is visible first, mowing coverage follows, then the live mower, while non-critical card chrome finishes afterwards.
- Settings and managed Schedule remain lazy and their Home Assistant native controls are not constructed until the user opens those dialogs.

### Regression coverage
- Add functional render-order tests.
- Add a regression test proving an unrelated Home Assistant entity update does not trigger map/live work on a closed card.

This beta is the first performance-refactor step. It flattens the normal dashboard hot path without removing compatibility for older Navimower installations or the beta3 scheduler behavior.
